purpose: Human Review Sample only; no human scoring performed

item.stem: According to the latest forecast, the pattern of pressure changes near the coast ____ before dawn.

explanation.answer_explanation: The singular head noun pattern takes the singular verb is; the intervening of-phrase does not change the subject.

distractor_rationales.A: Correct: is agrees with the singular subject pattern.
distractor_rationales.B: The plural verb are incorrectly agrees with pressure or changes instead of pattern.
distractor_rationales.C: This is a nonfinite fragment and does not provide a finite main verb.
distractor_rationales.D: This repeats the subject and omits the required finite verb construction after the blank.

taxonomy.subtype: subject-verb agreement across an intervening prepositional phrase

item.stem: The map archivist explained ____ during the survey.

options.A: where had the old boundary markers been moved
options.B: where the old boundary markers had been moved
options.D: where did the old boundary markers move

explanation.answer_explanation: An embedded question uses statement order: subject before the auxiliary, as in where the markers had been moved.

distractor_rationales.A: The auxiliary is inverted as in a direct question, so the embedded clause has the wrong word order.
distractor_rationales.B: Correct: the embedded question has the subject before the auxiliary.
distractor_rationales.C: The embedded clause is incomplete because it lacks a finite verb.
distractor_rationales.D: This uses direct-question inversion inside an embedded question.

taxonomy.subtype: embedded question with statement word order

item.stem: The sandstone tablet, ____ during the excavation, is now displayed in the conservation laboratory.

explanation.answer_explanation: The non-restrictive relative clause needs which as its marker and the passive verb phrase was uncovered.

distractor_rationales.A: What cannot introduce this non-restrictive relative clause.
distractor_rationales.B: Uncovering is the wrong verb form for the required passive predicate.
distractor_rationales.C: Correct: which introduces the clause and was uncovered is passive and finite.
distractor_rationales.D: The relative marker and a redundant subject pronoun duplicate the subject.

taxonomy.subtype: non-restrictive relative clause with passive predicate

item.stem: The telescope records extra images ____ the sky becomes clear after sunset.

explanation.answer_explanation: The time clause requires when followed by a subject and a finite verb: the sky becomes clear.

distractor_rationales.A: During is a preposition and cannot introduce the following finite clause.
distractor_rationales.B: The clause uses a nonfinite form instead of the required finite verb.
distractor_rationales.C: The subject and predicate are incorrectly ordered and the clause is not well formed.
distractor_rationales.D: Correct: when introduces a complete time clause with subject and finite verb.

taxonomy.subtype: time clause introduced by when

item.stem: The alloy remains flexible ____ repeated cooling and heating.

explanation.answer_explanation: Despite correctly introduces the noun phrase repeated cooling and heating to express contrast.

distractor_rationales.A: Correct: despite is followed directly by a noun phrase.
distractor_rationales.B: Although must introduce a finite clause, not the noun phrase that follows.
distractor_rationales.C: In spite requires the preposition of before this noun phrase.
distractor_rationales.D: Despite does not take of; the extra preposition is unnecessary.

taxonomy.subtype: contrast connector before a noun phrase

item.stem: The museum displayed ____ from the coastal excavation.

options.B: a finely work small bronze bowl
options.C: a finely worked old small bronze bowl
options.D: a finely worked small bronze bowl

explanation.answer_explanation: The participial modifier finely worked precedes the size adjective small, which precedes the material adjective bronze and the noun bowl.

distractor_rationales.A: The modifiers are ordered incorrectly around the participial adjective and material adjective.
distractor_rationales.B: Work is the wrong part-of-speech form; the participial modifier is worked.
distractor_rationales.C: The unnecessary adjective old adds an extraneous element to the planned noun phrase.
distractor_rationales.D: Correct: the modifier order is finely worked, small, bronze, bowl.

taxonomy.subtype: adjective order inside a complex noun phrase

item.stem: By the time the survey team arrived, the mineral samples ____ in sealed containers.

explanation.answer_explanation: The earlier completed event requires past perfect, and the samples receive the action, so the form is had been labeled.

distractor_rationales.A: The participle is malformed; label must be in its past-participial form.
distractor_rationales.B: Correct: had been labeled is past perfect passive.
distractor_rationales.C: The active form incorrectly makes the samples perform the labeling.
distractor_rationales.D: The passive auxiliary is missing its required past participle.

taxonomy.subtype: past perfect passive before a later past event

item.stem: The monitoring station's new filter made the river water ____ after heavy rainfall.

explanation.answer_explanation: Make takes an object followed by a bare predicate adjective: made the water clearer.

distractor_rationales.A: Correct: clearer is the adjective complement after the object river water.
distractor_rationales.B: Clearly is an adverb, not the required predicate adjective.
distractor_rationales.C: Make does not take to plus the infinitive in this object-complement pattern.
distractor_rationales.D: The -ing form does not function as the required adjective complement here.

taxonomy.subtype: causative verb with object plus predicate adjective

item.sentence: The calibration of the instruments record stable readings during each trial.

marked_parts.A: The calibration of the instruments record

explanation.answer_explanation: Calibration is the singular head of the subject noun phrase, so the main verb must be records.

taxonomy.subtype: singular head noun in an of-phrase subject

item.sentence: The northern route is considerably more shorter than the southern route during winter.

marked_parts.C: more shorter than the southern route

explanation.answer_explanation: Shorter is already a comparative form, so the redundant more must be removed.

taxonomy.subtype: comparative adjective without a redundant more marker

item.sentence: Last year, after the bridge had been inspected, engineers approves the repair plan.

marked_parts.A: Last year, after the bridge had been inspected,

explanation.answer_explanation: The explicit past-time adverb Last year and the past perfect passive clause establish a completed past narrative, so the main verb must be the simple past approved.

taxonomy.subtype: simple past main verb after a past perfect passive clause

item.sentence: The engineer selected several durability bearings for the test rig.

explanation.answer_explanation: The noun bearings needs an adjective modifier, so durable, not the noun durability, is required.

taxonomy.subtype: adjective required before a plural head noun

item.sentence: The plants grew slowly during the trial because of the soil remained unusually cold.

marked_parts.D: of the soil remained unusually cold.

explanation.answer_explanation: A finite clause follows because, whereas because of must be followed by a noun phrase.
explanation.minimal_correction: because of the soil remained unusually cold → because the soil remained unusually cold

taxonomy.subtype: because clause rather than because-of before a finite clause

item.sentence: The treatment plant replaced a concrete ancient pipe beneath the filtration basin.

explanation.answer_explanation: In this noun phrase, the age adjective ancient precedes the material adjective concrete, and the article changes to an.

taxonomy.subtype: adjective order inside a noun phrase

item.sentence: The archivist was deeply interested on maps from the coastal archive.

marked_parts.D: on maps from the coastal archive.

explanation.answer_explanation: The established adjective-preposition collocation is interested in, not interested on.

taxonomy.subtype: adjective-governed preposition in an interested-in phrase

item.sentence: The analyst could not determine why did the values change after calibration.

explanation.answer_explanation: The clause after determine is an embedded question and therefore uses statement order.
explanation.minimal_correction: why did the values change → why the values changed

taxonomy.subtype: embedded why-question with statement word order

item.sentence: The workshop focuses on carve wood and shaping clay for architectural models.

explanation.answer_explanation: The preposition on takes gerund complements, and carving must be parallel with shaping.

taxonomy.subtype: gerund complements coordinated after a training preposition

item.sentence: The strength of the coating is dependent of temperature and humidity.

explanation.answer_explanation: The established collocation is dependent on, so of is the wrong preposition.

taxonomy.subtype: adjective-governed dependent-on preposition

item.sentence: The collection of oral histories contain vivid accounts of migration from the valley.

marked_parts.A: The collection of oral histories contain

explanation.answer_explanation: The singular head noun collection controls agreement; the plural noun histories is inside an of-phrase.

taxonomy.subtype: singular head noun with an of-phrase interrupter

item.sentence: The panels, having built from recycled glass, were tested for strength.

explanation.answer_explanation: The panels receive the action, so the reduced modifier must be passive: built from recycled glass.
explanation.minimal_correction: having built from recycled glass → built from recycled glass

taxonomy.subtype: reduced passive modifier before a finite passive predicate
